text:
nina: Quick thread on the preview export UI for embeddings + rerank. Two items: (1) microcopy for the export CTA when provenance is enabled, and (2) keyboard / screen reader behavior for multi-page "select all matching" selections.

omar: For CTA, keep it short: "Export selected". Add an inline caption: "Includes model & source metadata" when provenance is on. Avoid long labels on primary buttons.

talia: agree on short CTA, but add an explicit aria-label: "Export selected vectors including provenance metadata" when toggled. Also make the caption a live description via aria-describedby.

dave: selection UX: when users do "select all matching" across pages we need a persistent banner in the modal: "You are exporting N items across M pages" with a small help link: "What does this include?". That link opens a keyboard-focusable dialog.

nina: good. Also we should surface sampling (if applied) directly: "Exporting N items (sampling: 10%) -> final: M items". That helps expectations.

omar: CSV columns: add explicit headers when provenance enabled: source_id,dataset,model,model_version,embed_ts. When disabled, only id,vector. Update backend contract accordingly.

talia: accessibility checklist: tooltip/dialog keyboard focus, aria-live for selection count updates, descriptive aria-label on CTA, focus trap in the export dialog, and visible focus styles on tiny help icons.

dave: copy for filename default: `workspace_vectors_YYYY-MM-DD[_prov].csv` or `.jsonl`. Keep consistent. Also add a small note under CTA: "Files may contain sensitive text from sources; follow workspace export policy."

aria-bot: (automation) Analytics event: export_vectors_initiated with attributes: format, include_provenance, selection_scope, sample_rate.

nina: thanks all, I'll update the Figma snippets, add the aria labels, and draft the backend payload example. Will ping when PR is ready for a11y pass. :thumbsup:
